modules.title: Introduction to Iwe Litireso (Written Literature)
modules.html:
Yoruba prose, poetry and drama. This section covers introduction to iwe litireso (written literature).

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of iwe litireso (written literature).
  • Be able to explain iwe litireso (written literature) in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Nínú àsà Yorùbá, ta ni ẹni tí ń mọ 'Ara'?
A: Ọbàtálá — Obatala is the deity responsible for molding the physical body (Ara) from clay.

Q: Nínú lítíréṣọ̀ àtẹnudẹ́nu, kí ni 'Àlọ̀ Àpagbe'?
A: Àlọ̀ tí ó ní orin — Àlọ̀ Àpagbe refers to folktales that involve songs where the audience joins in the chorus.

examples.q: Nínú àsà Yorùbá, ta ni ẹni tí ń mọ 'Ara'?
Nínú lítíréṣọ̀ àtẹnudẹ́nu, kí ni 'Àlọ̀ Àpagbe'?

quiz.q: Nínú àsà Yorùbá, ta ni ẹni tí ń mọ 'Ara'?
quiz.solution: Obatala is the deity responsible for molding the physical body (Ara) from clay.

quiz.q: Nínú lítíréṣọ̀ àtẹnudẹ́nu, kí ni 'Àlọ̀ Àpagbe'?

quiz.q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ 'ẹ̀mí' nínú gírámà nígbà tí a bá ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa 'I'?
quiz.solution: When referring to 'I', 'Èmi' is the first-person singular pronoun.

quiz.q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Object'?
quiz.solution: The Object of a sentence is called 'Àbọ̀'.

quiz.q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Good character'?
quiz.solution: Good character is 'Ìwà rere'.

quiz.q: Báwo ni a ṣe ń kí ẹni tí ó ń ṣiṣẹ́?
quiz.solution: 'Ẹ kú iṣẹ́' is the greeting for someone working.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Noun' ní èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ọ̀rọ̀ Orúkọ.

quiz.q: Ta ni ó kọ 'Igbo Olódùmarè'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: D.O. Fágúnwà.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Adjective'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ọ̀rọ̀ Àpèjúwe.

quiz.q: Iyán ń lọ pẹ̀lú:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ẹ̀gúsí.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Money'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Owó.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Drink'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Mu.

quiz.q: Àmì ohùn melo ló wà nínú èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Mẹ́ta (Do, Re, Mi).

quiz.q: Orúkọ 'Babatunde' jẹ́ orúkọ _____.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Orúkọ Àbísọ.

quiz.q: Kí ni a ń lò láti fi kọ 'Ewì'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ọgbọ́n àti èdè.

quiz.q: Ta ni òrìṣà tí ó ní ẹ̀tọ́ lórí irin àti ògún?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Ògún.

quiz.q: Kí ni orúkọ baba Ṣàngó?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Ọ̀ráńyàn.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ọ̀rọ̀ arọ́pò orúkọ ẹni kẹta ẹyọ?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ó.

quiz.q: Èwo ni kì í ṣe orìṣà ilẹ̀ Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Álá.

quiz.q: Kí ni orúkọ ọmọ tí a bí sípò èkejì nínú ìbejì?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Kẹ́hìndé.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú wọ̀nyí ni nọ́mbà 'Mẹ́wàá'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: 10.

quiz.q: A máa ń kí Ọba pé:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Kábíyèsí.

quiz.q: Irú òwe wo ni 'Adìyẹ funfun kò mọ ara rẹ̀ lágbà'?

quiz.q: Orúkọ mìíràn fún 'Ìyàwó' ni:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Aya.
